title: Authentication cookie headers
responsibility: Read opaque authentication cookies and construct secure cookie headers.

inputs.name: authCookies.request
inputs.description: Request whose Cookie header is inspected.

inputs.name: issueCookie.name
inputs.description: Cookie name to place in the header.

inputs.name: issueCookie.value
inputs.description: Cookie value to place in the header.

inputs.name: issueCookie.options
inputs.description: Max age in seconds and Lax or Strict SameSite choice.

inputs.name: clearCookie.sameSite
inputs.description: Lax or Strict SameSite choice for the expired cookie.

outputs.name: authCookies
outputs.description: Single value containing 32 to 128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; null for missing, malformed or duplicate cookies.

outputs.name: issueCookie
outputs.description: Set-Cookie value with root path, supplied max age, HttpOnly, Secure and supplied SameSite.

outputs.name: clearCookie
outputs.description: Set-Cookie value with an empty value and max age zero.
